Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.account

Interface AccountTokenRepository

public interface AccountTokenRepository
Port that stores single-use account tokens.

    • store

      void store(AccountToken token)
      Stores a new token.

      token - the token to store.

    • findUsable

      Optional<AccountToken> findUsable(String hashedToken, String purpose, Instant now)
      Finds an unused, unexpired token with the given hash and purpose, without consuming it, so that a caller can run every check before spending the token.
      Parameters:
      hashedToken - hash of the token value.
      purpose - purpose the token must have.
      now - current instant, compared against the expiry.
      Returns:
      the token, or an empty optional when there is no such usable token.

    • consume

      Optional<AccountToken> consume(String hashedToken, String purpose, Instant now)
      Consumes a token: finds an unused, unexpired token with the given hash and purpose and marks it as used, in one atomic step, so that two concurrent calls can never both succeed.
      Parameters:
      hashedToken - hash of the token value.
      purpose - purpose the token must have.
      now - current instant, compared against the expiry.
      Returns:
      the consumed token, or an empty optional when there is no such usable token.

    • deleteExpired

      int deleteExpired(Instant now)
      Deletes the tokens that expired before an instant.
      Parameters:
      now - current instant.
      Returns:
      the number of deleted tokens.
